about: The Seam Room's zones. Each zone is a real page. A zone is a box on the floor (x, z in metres; a missing side is open-ended). Where two boxes touch is a seam; a doorway is just a small zone box set in a wall opening. seam.js reads this through Seam.fromData(). room.js and agent/room-agent.mjs both read it, so a new zone added here is known to the room, the URL switching and the AI character at once.
